content: Typeform: standard utm_source/utm_medium/utm_campaign/utm_term/utm_content are captured automatically via Settings > Tracking (Source tracking) when present in the query string of the URL the browser loads to reach the hosted form.typeform.com/to/XXX link -- no hidden-field declaration needed. Custom params like 'referrer' require declaring a URL parameter (Workflow > Pull data in > Add new parameter) with a matching lowercase_underscore name; both ? query string and # hash fragment are supported on hosted (non-embedded) links, hash is recommended for sensitive values but query string works fine for non-sensitive attribution data.
